requirements: R1: Configure test datastore to ensure UserServiceTest boots and executes queries against a Postgres datastore.

slices.title: Configure Postgres Test Datastore
slices.jtbd: When implementing test datastore configuration for this epic, I want the test environment to provide a real Postgres instance, so that the missing test verification criteria are met.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the application runs in test, When a database query is executed by UserServiceTest, Then it runs against the correctly matching Postgres datastore without engine mismatch errors.
Given the test suite is invoked, When the relevant local verification command runs, Then it passes cleanly against the configured Postgres test datastore.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce failing tests due to datastore mismatch from 1 to 0

requirements: R1: Delete erroneously committed orchestrator artifacts and design-check screenshots.
R2: Supply missing backend dependencies to ensure privacy tests compile and pass.
R3: Mount PrivacySettings component in the main application routing in Russian.
R4: Replace mock API calls with real API calls in the mounted product path.
R5: Verify frontend integration with proper tests.

slices.title: Fix Data Subject Rights Implementation
slices.jtbd: When implementing the fixes for this epic, I want the missing dependencies supplied and the UI correctly mounted, so that the privacy settings are functional and verified.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the repository state, When inspected, Then the invalid orchestrator artifacts and screenshots are deleted.
Given the privacy backend tests, When executed, Then they compile and pass with all required dependencies supplied.
Given a user views their settings, When the page loads, Then the PrivacySettings component is mounted and accessible in Russian.
Given a user chooses to delete their account, When they confirm the warning, Then the action uses the real API in the product path.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Increase reachable privacy settings views from 0 to 1
